    tsets=[set((r,c) for r,c,_ in t) for t in templ]
    out=[row[:] for row in i_]
    for s in seeds:
        sr,sc,sv=s
        best=None

                    best=(key,(dr,dc),tcells)
        if best:
            _,(dr,dc),tcells=best
            for rr,cc,v in tcells: out[rr+dr][cc+dc]=v

from collections import deque
def comps(i_,bg):
    H,W=len(i_),len(i_[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if i_[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                st=[(r,c)]; cl=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or seen[a][b] or i_[a][b]==bg: continue
                    seen[a][b]=True; cl.append((a,b,i_[a][b]))
                    for ar2,br2 in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): st.append((a+ar2,b+br2))
                res.append(cl)
    return res

def f(i_):
    bg=i_[0][0]; H,W=len(i_),len(i_[0])
    ci=comps(i_,bg)
    tmpl=[cl for cl in ci if len({v for _,_,v in cl})>1][0]
    seeds=[cl[0] for cl in ci if len(cl)==1]
    tcol={v for _,_,v in tmpl}
    out=[row[:] for row in i_]
    for sr,sc,sv in seeds:
        if sv not in tcol: continue
        cands=[]
        for tr,tc,tv in tmpl:
            if tv!=sv: continue
            dr,dc=sr-tr,sc-tc
            ok=True
            for r,c,v in tmpl:
                nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): ok=False;break
                if (nr,nc)!=sr:(nr,nc)==(sr,sc) and v==sv: pass
                if (nr,nc)!=(sr,sc) and i_[nr][nc]!=bg: ok=False;break
            if ok: cands.append((abs(dr)+abs(dc),dr,dc,tmpl))
        if not cands: continue
        cands.sort(key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1],x[2]))
        for rr,cc,v in cands[0][3]: out[rr+cands[0][1]][cc+cands[0][2]]=v
    return out
